name: Chona
source: Somewhere in Southeast Asia, a struggling single mother wrestles to provide for her young son. Her work may be obscene, but her heart remains with her only family—at least, at first.  As time passes, the lure of wealth and luxury begins to pull her away, her focus shifting from motherhood to the seductive promises of her vocation.
